title: The Archive of the Deep
author: Lior Dunmore
blurb: Ines Vane, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
